name: Seafood
description: Dive into the ocean of flavors with our exquisite seafood collection. Fresh, succulent, and full of the sea's briny essence, these dishes are a true delicacy.

name: Lamb
description: Savor the rich, tender taste of premium lamb. Perfect for roasting, grilling, or stewing, our lamb recipes promise a hearty and satisfying meal.

name: Starter
description: Kick off your meal with a bang! Our starters are designed to tantalize your taste buds and set the stage for an unforgettable dining experience.

name: Chicken
description: Versatile and delicious, our chicken recipes cover everything from comfort food classics to exotic new favorites. A staple for any kitchen.

name: Beef
description: Experience the bold and robust flavors of our best beef dishes. Whether it's a juicy steak or a slow-cooked stew, satisfaction is guaranteed.

name: Dessert
description: Go on a taste journey, where every sip is a sophisticated creative chord, and every dessert is an expression of the most refined gastronomic desires.

name: Vegan
description: Plant-based perfection! Explore our vibrant vegan recipes that prove you don't need animal products to create mouthwatering, nutritious meals.

name: Pork
description: Indulge in the savory goodness of pork. From crispy bacon to tender roasts, our recipes celebrate the versatility and flavor of this beloved meat.

name: Vegetarian
description: Fresh, colorful, and meat-free! key into our vegetarian selection where vegetables take center stage, offering both health benefits and incredible taste.

name: Miscellaneous
description: A treasure trove of culinary curiosities! Discover unique recipes that defy categorization but promise to delight your palate with every bite.

name: Pasta
description: Twirl your fork into happiness with our pasta dishes. From creamy sauces to zesty tomato bases, we bring the authentic taste of Italy to your table.

name: Breakfast
description: Rise and shine with our breakfast favorites. Whether you prefer sweet or savory, we have the perfect morning meal to start your day right.

name: Side
description: The perfect companions to your main course. Our side dishes are crafted to complement and elevate your meal, adding flavor and variety to your plate.

name: Goat
description: Discover the distinct and earthy flavor of goat meat. Our recipes guide you through preparing this nutritious protein in delicious and traditional ways.

name: Soup
description: Warm your soul with a bowl of our homemade soup. From hearty stews to light broths, comfort comes in many flavors in our soup collection.
